simple.meaning: רֶסֶן (reçen) is a Hebrew animal word meaning “a halter (as restraining ); by implication, the jaw.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Job 30:11. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רֶסֶן (H7448) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: רֶסֶן (reçen) / H7448 is traced through Job 30:11, Job 41:5, Psalms 32:9, Isaiah 30:28 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me;
Will you play with him as with a bird?

His breath is as an overflowing stream that reaches even to the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction. A bridle that leads to ruin will be in the jaws of the peoples.

definitions.short: a halter (as restraining ); by implication, the jaw
definitions.full: H7448. resen I. רֶ֫סֶן noun masculine Isa 30:28 : 1 halter ; 2 jaw (?); — 1 absolute ׳ר Psa 32:9 restraining mouth of horse or ass (+ מֶתֶג ); figurative of עַמִּים׳ר עַללְֿחָיֵי י, ׳שֵׁם Isa 30:28 ; ׳ר שִׁלֵּ֑חוּ מִמָּנַי Job 30:11 , i.e. threw off restraint. 2 suffix רִסְנוֺ כֶּפֶל Job 41:5 the double of his jaw , his double jaws (of croc.), si vera 1.; connection of meanings strange, || לְבוּשׁוֺ מְּנֵי , whence GHBW right Du conjecture סִיֹנוֺ .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to curb ;
